Perturbation family: covariate set

Source: R/families.R
stress_covariates.Rd

Refits the model with each covariate dropped in turn, with no covariates, and with any user-supplied covariate sets.

Usage

stress_covariates(
  spec,
  drop_each = TRUE,
  drop_all = TRUE,
  sets = list(),
  cores = 1L
)

Arguments

spec

A stress_spec().

drop_each

Drop each pre-specified covariate term in turn.

drop_all

Fit with treatment and visit only.

sets

Named list of additional covariate sets (formulas or character vectors of term labels); each is fitted as given.

cores

Number of worker processes; 1 fits sequentially.

Value

A stress_rows data frame.

Examples

spec <- stress_spec(mmrm::fev_data, "FEV1", "USUBJID", "AVISIT", "ARMCD", "PBO",
                    covariates = ~ RACE + SEX + FEV1_BL)
stress_covariates(spec, sets = list("with weight" = ~ RACE + SEX + FEV1_BL + WEIGHT))
